heard: The full moon has zero effect on human crime. We've blamed lunar cycles for hospital chaos for centuries. Many police and doctors still swear it causes madness. Scientific reviews analyzed over 30 years of crime statistics. They looked for a spike during one specific moon phase. Instead, they found admission rates were identical on four other days. The final correlation between the moon and madness is exactly zero. Moonlight triggers coral spawning, but it won't change your behavior. Decades of evidence confirm the moon has zero effect on human crime.
